body.x: NUVIZ participated in “CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2018 Unveiled” held on January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to introduce a wearable device for motorcycles, “NUVIZ Ride”.

Equipped with a HUD (Head-up Display), NUVIZ Ride allows you to understand the pertinent information while your vision is secured. You don’t have to purchase the whole helmet, but only the device to attach it to your existing helmet. The display equipment mounted to the NUVIZ Ride provides its users with convenience. With this helmet you can frequently analyze your situation. This product can even be connected to a network through Wi-fi or Bluetooth 4.0.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
